title: Verify split part release
acceptance_criteria: An offline read-only probe distinguishes after_plan hold, queued/startable release, and durable SWE dispatch for pm-255/t-1557; missing, mismatched or incomplete evidence fails. Unit fixtures prove the release and negative controls without board writes.
problem: pm-255's abandoned predecessor still holds it, and a release claim can be mistaken for queueing or submission. Otohime needs a reproducible acceptance probe over independently fetched board evidence; the scheduler fix is assigned separately to mono-v2.
action_items: At the start inspect pm-260's operator_action fingerprint release-after-plan:pm-255:pm-248; reuse the existing action. If absent and the plan is still held/paused, raise plan_manager_ask_user kind=operator_action for a privileged operator to clear only pm-255's after_plan edge conditionally on pm-248 still being abandoned, resume pm-255, and record the parent note on its timeline. This is a board administration chore, not runtime provisioning. End that run with the chore id; do not spend a fix cycle. On relaunch the offline implementation does not require real dispatch.

Declare lib/plan-release.ts with a pure evaluator taking decoded get_plan, explain_schedule, get_timeline and list_runs JSON snapshots plus expected plan_id, predecessor_id and task_id. Return separate booleans hold_released, queued_startable, execution_started, release_recorded and dispatch_proven, and stable missing-evidence reasons. Require explicit recognized fields; absent progress is not release.

Implement scripts/probe-plan-release.mjs using the evaluator, with --plan, --schedule, --timeline, --runs JSON file arguments, --plan-id pm-255, --predecessor-id pm-248, --task-id t-1557 and --require released|dispatched (default dispatched). It only reads local snapshots and prints JSON; exit 0 for released only with hold_released, release_recorded and either queued_startable or execution_started; dispatched also requires execution_started and dispatch_proven. Unsupported/incomplete inputs exit nonzero.

Require matching plan/task ids; hold_released requires progress.reason != after_plan and progress.state in the known live/startable/finishing_only states. queued_startable requires plan queued and progress startable. execution_started requires a non-null execution_started_at and a recognized executing/finishing/done plan state. release_recorded requires a timeline decision naming pm-248 and its abandoned note. dispatch_proven requires a software_engineer run for t-1557 with a nonempty tm_task_id and a submitted/running/finished outcome, excluding scheduled-only or unrelated runs. Preserve source run ids and outcome; failure is not product delivery.

Write lib/plan-release.test.ts and CLI integration tests with temporary files for real API-shaped synthetic fixtures: held/paused, released queued/startable, released with execution and durable SWE task id, missing progress, old execution timestamp with current after_plan hold, wrong plan/task, missing timeline note, merely scheduled run, truncated evidence, and a failed SWE attempt. A failed attempt may prove dispatch only, never delivery.

Document snapshot collection through the four existing MCP read tools in projects/fix-for-slow-plan-pm-255-task-duration-spell-slow-pm-255-tas/release-walkthrough.md, including captured_at, completeness and SHA metadata outside the raw payloads. Keep credentials out. Prove CLI behavior against fixtures now; leave real board walkthrough to QA/acceptance. Commit and push using the assigned pm-260/task prefix.
non_goals: Scheduler or watchdog changes in otohime
Board writes or privileged operator tools in a delivery role
Changing Ask features or t-1557/t-1558 contracts
Adding an external service, dependency or polling job
Claiming dispatch demonstrates t-1557 product delivery
